content.short: A Horde of Zombies Roaming the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description:
It all began back in September of 2021. Founded by three friends with a passion for art, zombies and all things Cardano – ADA Apocalypse rose from the grave.

The Horde have infected the Cardano Blockchain since the beginning – building one of the strongest communities around. Throughout the journey we have always strived to bring unique concepts and original art while spreading the Apocalypse vibe.
